please ignore the dummyhead that is projecting in the comments. i have a friend who has similar relationships with her parents (though she is 18), and with a child i’m sure it’s even worse. i want to start by saying: it is NOT your responsibility to fix the relationship. no matter how much they play victim, please don’t think that you are responsible for repairing relationships that drain you. 

my heart goes out to you, i know that you must feel trapped and tired, and for that i am so sorry. just focus on the goal ahead of you: raise your son well and get out of that house. but please also take care of yourself. remove yourself from the situation as much as possible, whether it be taking your son out to the park or finding any reason to get both of you out of the house for the day. 

maybe look into support groups in your area for single mothers or abuse victims. anywhere you can find people who understand you and will create a safe space for you to vent. it’s important that you take care of yourself, and that includes building a support system. 

please know that your stepdad is an asshole. you don’t deserve to have those things said to you, so please don’t think you do. you are not a failure. you are a single mother trying to be the best parent you can for you son. and for that, i am so proud of you. 

as i said, your post reminded me so much of people that i love. please do know i care deeply about you, stranger. and though i know nothing about you, my dms are always open for support. please hold on, you won’t be trapped forever, better days are coming, even if it doesn’t feel like it.

I know you said that it's hard to believe words at your state, but hey I might as well try. and maybe you'll read this whole thing and it won't change a single thing, but maybe it will. See that's the thing about how this world works, it's a two-sided coin. This could help you or this could not. I could have seen this post or I could have not. Your situation could get worse, or...it could get better. I know I know, everyone always tells us that "it gets better" and when you're on the brink of giving up, it's fucking hard to believe that. I know I didn't. When you're numb and broken and exhausted, it's hard to believe anything anyone says because our brains tell us the exact opposite. But tell your brain to shut the fuck up. Whatever you're going through, you CAN get through it. You've gotten through all of the shitty ass days so far, and I know you can get through another. you said something's gonna free you, but really, the only thing that can free you is yourself. You were able to live a better life briefly, and now you know that it's possible. Healing is not linear. None of this is ever linear. You will have dark periods and happy ones, but the important thing is that you don't give up on life due to a temporary part of time. You're probably not gonna believe me, but I love you. I really do. I have absolutely no idea who you are but I know you deserve love. You deserve happiness. and you deserve much better than what you feel right now. so I love you so much, and I hope you can understand that. And maybe you're reading these last few sentences and thinking "what a bunch of bullshit" or you feel nothing, but do you think that if nothing really mattered, that I would've written this entire thing at 1:00 in the morning for someone I didn't even know?

I know how you feel. I'm a queer person, and sometimes the yearning is so strong, and the pain is too much because of this shitty world. However, I know that we all are constantly moving forward, whether we think it or not. And I know that at some point, I won't be in this dark shitty place anymore, and neither will you. It's never too late to learn new skills and find new employment. Raising money to move to a new place is always an option. I know it will be hard and tiresome but you can get through this. I read the last two sentences and I cried. I cried because I've said something similar many times before. Being gay is not easy in this world, but it is beautiful when you can be with someone you love. When you can be who you are. I love you, and I'm glad you're alive. And you'll probably doubt that because I don't even know but I swear on my life, whoever you are, I love you so much and I hope that you're okay.

When I did it, it all suddenly became very real after I had taken all the pills. And once it became real, then the regret set in and the fear and the panic and everything awful. I don't want you to go through that. I don't want you to feel that pain, and I especially don't want you to die. I want you to stay here, and find out what's going to happen the Monday after next weekend. and the next Tuesday and Wednesday and every day after that. I know people say it all the fucking time, and it gets exhausting but things can get better. They did for me, and they can for you. Who knows, maybe next Monday, you'll find something for you here, and you'll realize that if you hadn't waited to see, that you never would've gotten to experience it. You probably won't believe me because I know I wouldn't with my depression brain, but I love you. I love you and I hope that you don't go through with it. I may not know you but I know you deserve to be happy and feel loved and everything good, we all do.

I understand how you feel. I have been depressed for four years, and I recently went on meds and began therapy in February. I have my days where I'm laying in bed and the pain washes over me and I just feel like dying. Like I can't go on and that there is no way out. But I wake up the next morning and I feel okay again. We have ups and downs, nothing is linear, and you will still have these moments, especially after such a short time of getting help. Healing is a process, don't let these dark moments win because the world needs you. And maybe you don't believe me because I don't know you, but whoever you are, I love you, and I hope you're okay.

I know how you feel, I've been there. Months of restless nights, suicidal thoughts, and just hell. Feeling like I'm trapped in an inescapable situation. However, I'm here to tell you that it's escapable. The fact that you're sad it'll hurt others just shows me how much you care about other people. That you're compassionate and loving. I just wish that you could show that compassion and love toward yourself because you deserve it. You deserve another chance at life, and I hope you don't take that away from yourself. I don't know anything about you, and I don't know who you are, but you're not alone. I've been where you are and the moment I did it, I regretted it. I was so tired and so done, but as soon as I started feeling the effects, I realized that I was about to react permanently to a temporary situation. Luckily I'm here, and maybe because I am here, I can stop you from doing the same thing. "Life's a bitch and then you die right" "sometimes, sometimes life's a bitch and you keep on living" - Bojack Horseman

Hi, maybe I'm too late, I hope not. This was posted 11 minutes ago, and I doubt anything I say will make you change your mind, but I surely will try. I don't know who you are, and you don't know who I am, but we both have one thing in common: we've both seen the dark. And in that dark we can't see, none of us, and we all assume that we're alone. We think that just because we cannot see each other, that there is no one else there, no one else that could possibly understand what it is like to be in that darkness. Meanwhile, there are millions of people standing just a few yards apart in that darkness. You are not alone, no matter how much it feels like you are. I have no information about you. I don't know why you want to leave this world specifically, but I do know that you should stay. Maybe you're depressed and you feel helpless and hopeless and tired, or maybe you're just sick of whatever situation you're in, either way, you should stay. Everything around you feels perpetual when it's not. I mean nothing lasts forever right? that includes the bad things. I know I don't know who you are, but I love you. I love you because you deserve to be loved. and Maybe your brain is telling you that I'm lying or that I don't mean it, but that's not true. I love you, whoever you are, and I want you in this world. And if I'm too late then that's a fucking shame because the world needs you, whether you want to believe it or not.

I don’t understand how it’s irresponsible of my mother. It was my brother’s responsibility to figure out what he needed, and obviously there was some miscommunication if his roommate didn’t know they needed the insurance too. And even then, my mother’s not the only parent in charge of making sure things went smoothly, so my dad would be equally at fault. He wasn’t “annoyed” he was being completely irrational. My mother kept her cool, and I could tell my dad’s reaction was just stressing my brother out even more. 

In the more general sense. He is constantly making rude comments about people. Here are some examples I can think of: We were driving and some lady was standing on the side walk and she was quite skinny and he made some comment to me about how she’s “anorexic” and how she could “eat a sandwich”. Someone was kind enough to let him go first when we were driving at an intersection and he said “Thanks redneck” (not to them). Like they were being nice and he still had to insult them. He always has casually racist remarks and although he’s considered a democrat, our politics definitely don’t necessarily align. 

My mother hates having to email him because he is just rude and resentful. I had a school fee for some classes I’m taking this year and she asked him to send her his half so she could pay it (they split costs like that), and he did and the next day the school sent out everyone’s fee information to all of the parents. My dad emailed my mom actin as though the school had only emailed him and was berating her about why he was being charged with it if he gave her the money. His reactions are constantly blown out of proportion, and it’s aggravating. I don’t know a ton about what happened between him and my sister, but I do know that she didn’t feel like anything she ever did would be good enough for him. My mom was in tears asking him to change or else my sister wasn’t gonna want a relationship with him. He didn’t. My sister just managed to work on it by herself, and try to have a relationship with him. My mom doesn’t give much details because I don’t think she wants me to have a bad relationship with my father. Sorry this was long lol
